headline: Decibel Cannabis Reports Third-Quarter 2026 Revenue Growth
summary: Decibel Cannabis Company reported quarterly revenue grew 7% year-over-year to $35.1 million, with international sales reaching a record $12.1 million, while reaffirming its full-year outlook.
why: Decibel Cannabis Company is a publicly reported cannabis enterprise whose financial results and international sales figures indicate sector performance trends.
